quarterly_data.quarter: OpenAI press release: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: OpenAI and Google Cloud are partnering to bring OpenAI's frontier models and Codex agentic workflows into Google Cloud's Model Garden; Google Cloud customers will be able to purchase OpenAI frontier models via Model Garden, transacted through the Google Cloud Marketplace, and enterprises with Google Cloud spend commitments will be able to draw down their GCP commitments for these purchases. OpenAI models will soon be available in Google Antigravity and the Gemini Agent. General availability is planned in the coming weeks. OpenAI: 'Microsoft remains OpenAI's primary cloud partner.' President and co-founder Greg Brockman called the partnership 'an important step in making our most capable models and Codex available where customers are already building'.

connects_to.relationship: OpenAI frontier models and Codex offered to Google Cloud customers through Model Garden / Google Cloud Marketplace
